name: GIRDER 格拉德 Corsa 2025 105 mechanical
why_interesting: GIRDER's lowest-priced current carbon road complete: 105 R7120 mechanical, T47 and 50 mm carbon wheels at an official ¥9,999, with its own three-size geometry.

facts.drivetrain: Shimano 105 R7120 mechanical 2×12; FC-R7100 52-36T 170 mm crank, CS-R7100 11-34T cassette; chain not listed
facts.frame: 2025 CORSA T800 + T1000 carbon aero frame and fork, 12 mm thru-axles, UDH dropout, fully hidden routing (the page repeats the Shimano battery-storage line on this mechanical build)
facts.frame_material: T800 + T1000 carbon frame (reinforced bottom-bracket area) and fork; fiber supplier and lay-up are not published
facts.frame_construction: EPS-molded aero frame and fork with fully hidden routing
facts.stiffness_evidence: No measured or comparative stiffness evidence found; the reinforced bottom-bracket wording is manufacturer construction copy, not a test result
facts.bottom_bracket: T47 threaded, P1.0 thread, 84.5 mm shell width supplied with two 1 mm shims (the frame line separately says 'BSA'; the BB row is the more specific value)
facts.wheels: Adler Augen matte unpainted Obsidian carbon wheels, 50 mm, four-bearing 90-point six-pawl hubs, flattened steel spokes
facts.tires: Maxxis 700C×28C folding tires fitted; maximum clearance is not published
facts.geometry: Official chart, stack/reach mm: 440 535/382, 470 545/384, 500 569/397; seat angle 75.5–74°, head angle 72–73°, chainstay 410 mm, BB drop 72 mm, wheelbase 984–999 mm, head tube 115–147 mm
facts.complete_weight_basis: Manufacturer-listed weight for this complete bike; size, pedals and weighing method are not stated

missing: Complete-weight size, pedal and measurement basis

official_price.price_basis: Manufacturer-listed price on the exact NEW 2025 CORSA page; no mainland marketplace listing or checkout amount was observed
